definitions.explanation: A traditional Japanese sweet drink made from fermented rice or sake lees (酒粕). It has a thick, slightly sweet, porridge-like consistency and is served either hot or cold.

examples.japanese: {甘酒|あまざけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}んだ→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{温|あたた}かい→温かい：13395_atatakai⟧{甘酒|あまざけ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{恋|こい}しく→恋しい：03055_koishii⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: When winter comes, I start craving warm amazake.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
Amazake is closely associated with winter and New Year's celebrations. It is commonly served at shrines during ⟦{初詣|はつもうで}→初詣：05804_hatsumoude⟧ (New Year's visit) and at {雛祭|ひなまつ}り (Doll Festival, March 3). Despite the name containing ⟦{酒|さけ}→酒：02211_sake⟧ (alcohol), the ⟦{米麹|こめこうじ}→米麹：25200_komekouji⟧ (rice malt) version is non-alcoholic and safe for children. The ⟦{酒粕|さけかす}→酒粕：14773_sakekasu⟧ (sake lees) version does contain a small amount of alcohol.

TYPES:
- ⟦{米麹|こめこうじ}→米麹：25200_komekouji⟧{甘酒|あまざけ}: made from rice malt, naturally sweet, non-alcoholic
- ⟦{酒粕|さけかす}→酒粕：14773_sakekasu⟧{甘酒|あまざけ}: made from sake lees, slightly alcoholic

- {甘酒|あまざけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧: to drink amazake
